episodes.synopsis: Years after his victory at Megalonia, Joe has become a completely different man, going from one underground ring to another, now fighting as the wandering boxer Nomad.
episodes.title: Los fantasmas tararean un réquiem

episodes.synopsis: Joe gets his motorcycle stolen by a boy named Mio and ends up at a settlement for immigrants where he runs into Chief again.
episodes.title: La desesperación da coraje a los cobardes

episodes.synopsis: Joe helps Chief get ready to fight in the upcoming tournament while dealing with is own demons.
episodes.title: Si deseas la dañina pudrición de las raíces, no bloquees la boca del ánfora

episodes.synopsis: Chief fights in the last match of the tournament. Will he be victorious?
episodes.title: Si la flor del alma florece, el amor no se perderá

episodes.synopsis: Joe heads back home to face his past.
episodes.title: La tierra prometida respondió que el mesiás no se quedará

episodes.synopsis: Sachio ends up injuring a Megalo-boxer after they caused trouble at Bonjiri's shop. In retaliation, the Megalo-boxer comes back and trashes the place and steals the deed to the shop.
episodes.title: Aunque estés consciente de tu impotencia, Dios te ofrecerá su imagen para que la pises

episodes.synopsis: Liu finds out Joe is back in town and asks him to be his sparring partner. Mac Rosario had once lost everything, but made a miraculous comeback as the local hero.
episodes.title: El tonto que muestra su carta no es un payaso estúpido

episodes.synopsis: Mac and Liu face off in the ring finally. Maya goes to talk to Sakuma after she finds Mac acting strange.
episodes.title: Al principio del fin, la trayectoria del arcoíris dibuja un soportal

episodes.synopsis: Joe continues to try to rebuild Gym Nowhere and Yukiko has some questions for Sakuma about BES.
episodes.title: Una sola mano no basta para vivir, pero aun así la forma de vivir prevalece

episodes.synopsis: The executives don't like Yukiko's decision to possibly end the company's partnership with ROSCO. Meanwhile, Joe and Sachio settle things once and for all.
episodes.title: Las derrotas pasadas son acompañadas por señales de buena suerte

episodes.synopsis: It's decided that Mac and Joe will get into the ring together, but Mac finds out something shocking from Maya...
episodes.title: Cuando te quitas la armadura que no te podías quitar, brotan las semillas de la miseria y de la dicha

episodes.synopsis: Mac falls into despair when he finds out the truth and encounters a familiar face from his past.
episodes.title: Aunque las ovaciones se callen, la voz de los mudos no desaparecerá

episodes.synopsis: Joe and Mac head into the ring to have their legendary match.
episodes.title: El con alas lleva al sin alas, y el sin alas bendice al con alas
